visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two individuals—a male with a high-pitched vertical mohawk and a female with a wide, fanned-out hair arrangement—stand in a close-up framing. A stylized, animated gray shark character wearing a brown vest is superimposed in a circular frame above their heads. The background is a dimly lit indoor space with soft ceiling lights. (2) The screen transitions to a split-screen format. In the top half, the animated shark performs a rhythmic dance with sharp arm extensions and stepping motions. In the bottom half, the same man and woman, now wearing matching brown jackets over red shirts, mimic the shark's choreography inside a bright living room. A large television and white walls are visible in the background. (3) The pair undergoes a rapid visual transition into new costumes, featuring purple padded jackets, dark wigs, and prominent black fake mustaches to match the shark's new on-screen persona. They continue to mirror the energetic dance moves, including exaggerated arm swings and a rapid spinning motion. (4) A large white and red graphic for 'The Bad Guys 2' movie logo covers the top portion of the screen. The male character stands to the right, gesturing with his hand toward the promotional text and release date information displayed at the bottom of the frame, while the female character stands to the left in a matching pose.
